06:00 p.m.

I.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS:
II.
CLOSED SESSION:
a.
Conference with Legal Counsel - Existing Litigation, per Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1): City of La Habra v. Cohen, Sacramento County Superior Court Case No. 34-2015-80002208.
III.
ADJOURNMENT:
Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the foregoing agenda. A copy of the full agenda packet is available for public review at the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours or on the City's webpage at http://www.lahabraca.gov/.
Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Authority/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at 110 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, during normal business hours
In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.

Iab Beautification

c.

Ic CM CalDomestic annual rpt LH 20160201
Ic CalDomestic annual rpt 20150201 final
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
PROPOSED ITEMS:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
Approve second reading and adoption of ORDINANCE NO. 1768 ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA AMENDING SECTIONS 5.12.030 THROUGH 5.12.100 AND DELETING SECTIONS 5.12.110 THROUGH 5.12.140 OF CHAPTER 5.12 OF TITLE 5 OF THE LA HABRA MUNICIPAL CODE, RELATING TO HANDBILLING.
III2 Ord 1768
3.
Receive and file Planning Commission Minutes of:
a.
October 26, 2015
III3a CD PC Min 10'26'15
b.
November 23, 2015
III3b CD PC Min 11'23'15
c.
December 14, 2015
III3c CD PC Min 12'14'15
4.
Adopt a resolution prohibiting stopping, standing and parking at all times on the north side of Whittier Boulevard west of Harbor Boulevard.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _____ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON WHITTIER BOULEVARD WEST OF HARBOR BOULEVARD.
III4 PW 1001 E Whittier
5.
Approve the Notice of Completion for the Harbor Boulevard and Lambert Road Intersection improvements, Project No. 5-TC-09; approve Change Order No. 1 in the amount of $40,000.00; approve Change Order No. 2 in the amount of $56,978.30; approve Change Order No. 3 in the amount of $16,277.25; appropriate $19,377.25 from available Gas Tax Fund balance to fund additional costs related to the project; and authorize the City Manager to increase the Purchase Order amount by $19,377.25.
III5 PW NOC Harbor Lanbert Inters
6.
Approve the Notice of Completion for the Whittier Boulevard and Beach Boulevard Intersection improvements, Project No. 6-TC-09; approve Change Order 1 in the amount of $19,471.54; approve Change Order 2 in the amount of $66,372.72; approve Change Order 3 in the amount of $46,857.36; and approve Change Order 4 in the amount of $87,285.42
III6 NOC Whittier Beach Inters
7.
Approve staff's recommendations regarding Project No. 1-D-15 as follows:
a.
Approve Specifications for the East Bishop Drive Temporary Channel Bracing, Project No. 1-D-15; and
b.
Award a contract for the construction of the East Bishop Drive Temporary Channel Bracing, Project No. 1-D-15 to Robert D. Gosney Construction of Hesperia, California in the amount of $24,280.00 and reject all other bids; and
c.
Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Robert D. Gosney Construction and authorize staff to issue a purchase order in the amount of $26,708.00 that includes a 10 percent contingency; and
d.
Appropriate additional $4,108.00 from Capital Projects Fund to cover the cost increase of construction of the East Bishop Drive Temporary Channel Bracing Project 1-D-15.
III7 PW Award Bishop temp Channel
8.
Approve staff's recommendations regarding a request to review the Lindauer Drive and Laguna Drive Neighborhood as follows:
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _____ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA DESIGNATING THE INTERSECTION OF LINDAUER DRIVE AND LAGUNA DRIVE AS AN ALL-WAY STOP INTERSECTION.
b.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _____ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA DESIGNATING THE INTERSECTIONS OF LINDAUER DRIVE AT LA MIRADA STREET AND LINDAUER DRIVE AT VERNON STREET AS ALL-WAY STOP INTERSECTIONS.
c.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _____ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA DESIGNATING THE INTERSECTIONS OF LAGUNA DRIVE AT LA MIRADA STREET AND LAGUNA STREET AT VERNON STREET AS ALL-WAY STOP INTERSECTIONS.
d.
Approve Eastbound and Northbound "No Left Turn" restrictions during the 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. time periods Monday through Friday only at Hacienda Road and Laguna Drive.
e.
Approve Southbound "No Right Turn" restrictions during the 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. time period, Monday through Friday only, on Hacienda Road at Lindauer Drive and at Laguna Drive.
f.
Approve Southbound "Keep Clear" restrictions on Hacienda Road at Laguna Drive.
III8 PW Lindauer Laguna neighborhood
9.
Adopt a resolution prohibiting stopping, standing and parking at all times on Martinez Drive at Blake Street.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. _____ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON MARTINEZ DRIVE AT BLAKE STREET.
III9 PW Martinez Dr Blake St
10.
Adopt a resolution prohibiting stopping, standing and parking at all times on the east side of Palm Street north of Lambert Road.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON PALM STREET NORTH OF LAMBERT ROAD.
III10 PW Palm Lamber
11.
Adopt a resolution prohibiting stopping, standing and parking at all times on the south side of Whittier Boulevard west of Chestnut Street.
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON WHITTER BOULEVARD WEST OF CHESTNUT STREET.
III11 PW Whittier Chestnus
12.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00105008 through 00105183 totaling $1,570,997.65.
III12 FAS Warrants 20160201
IV.
CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS REMOVED FOR SEPARATE DISCUSSION:
V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: None at this time.
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS: None at this time.
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
